Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Rohan - 9 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Kavita - 42 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Sanjay - 45 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama
4. Savitri - 65 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair
5. Rishabh - 11 years, friend
Look: red T-shirt, jeans

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The garden - flower beds, a mango tree

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Rohan stands in the living room. Kavita and Savitri stand near him.]

Kavita: "Today feels like a good day."

[Rohan writes in his notebook.]

Rohan: "Mom, listen!"

[Rohan sits cross-legged on the floor.]

Rohan: "Yes, of course."

Scene 2: The garden - Day

[Rohan stands in the garden. Kavita and Sanjay stand near him.]

Kavita: "Rohan, look over here."

[Rohan waters the plants.]

Rohan: "Hey, look at that!"

[Rohan chases a butterfly in the garden.]

Rohan: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
